home.outletCardDesc: Premium eyewear from past collections at sale prices. For a limited time.
home.svc1Desc: Complete exams with the latest technology. Free when you buy glasses.
home.svc2Desc: Personalised contact lens fitting for your maximum comfort.
home.svc3Desc: Fast, hassle-free official exams. Book yours now.
home.examePara: Book your optometry appointment with our specialists. The exam is completely free when you buy your new glasses or if you don't need a prescription.
home.consultPara: We don't just sell glasses. We believe your frame is the frame of your face. Our team uses face-mapping techniques to find the models that best harmonise with your features, skin tone and lifestyle.
home.consult1Text: A detailed study of the shape and proportions of your face.
home.consult2Text: Identifying the tones (warm or cool) that brighten your eyes.
home.consult3Text: A personalised selection from our premium portfolio.
home.sobrePara: For over 38 years we have cared for the vision of Parede families, with the rigour of an accredited team and the closeness of those who know their customers by name. Cutting-edge technology, premium brands and service that makes the difference.
